dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, is your new laptop easy to use?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪz jʊr ˈnuː ˈlæptɑːp ˈiːzi tə ˈjuːz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it's very user-friendly. But the instructions are hard to read.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪts ˈvɛri ˌjuːzər ˈfrɛndli. bʌt ði ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ər ˈhɑːrd tə ˈriːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The words are too small! And the settings are complicated.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwɜːrdz ər ˈtuː ˈsmɔːl! ənd ðə ˈsɛtɪŋz ər ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What do you want to change?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈtʃeɪndʒ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The language. I want Thai and English.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ. aɪ ˈwɑːnt ˈtaɪ ənd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let me see. Here it is. It's easy to find.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛt miː ˈsiː. ˈhɪr ɪt ˈɪz. ɪts ˈiːzi tə ˈfaɪnd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thanks! Is your laptop easy to carry?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks! ɪz jʊr ˈlæptɑːp ˈiːzi tə ˈkæri?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Not really. It's heavy and hard to carry, but it's very practical for studying.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ɪts ˈhɛvi ənd ˈhɑːrd tə ˈkæri, bʌt ɪts ˈvɛri ˈpræktɪkəl fər ˈstʌdiɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mine is small and easy to carry. I can take it to class every day.
dialogue.reading: ˈmaɪn ɪz ˈsmɔːl ənd ˈiːzi tə ˈkæri. aɪ kən ˈteɪk ɪt tə ˈklæs ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.
